data.narrative:
Profluent, a seed-stage biotech company founded by Ali Madani, has raised $150M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private companies in the Biotech & Health sector, including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Only one valuation method proved applicable given data constraints. Stage-Progression anchoring uses a $5M proxy derived from total capital raised and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of the Seed-to-next-stage transition, yielding $12M. Peer-Median triangulation was not feasible: while 7 same-sector private peers exist, none met the narrow filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier comparables—fewer than the 3 datapoints needed for reliable medians. Public-Comp Anchoring could not be applied because Profluent's revenue is not disclosed, preventing use of the 6.6x P/S median observed across the public comp set.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $11M to $14M, centered at $12M. This range is derived from a single method and therefore carries material uncertainty. Key gaps limiting precision include the absence of revenue data for multiple-application approaches and the scarcity of closely-matched seed-stage biotech peers with disclosed valuations. Higher conviction would require either disclosed revenue or expanded peer data at comparable stages and scale.
